title: Verify Resend Email - Full Magic Link Flow via Email
description: Verify that magic links are actually delivered to the user's email inbox and the full auth flow works via email.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start dev server: bun run dev
Enter etan@heyman.net and click 'Send Magic Link'
Check actual email inbox for magic link email from Resend
Verify email contains clickable magic link URL
Click magic link from email (or copy/paste URL)
Take screenshot - user is logged in, shows 'Welcome, Admin!'
Take screenshot - returns to login form
